news.headline: Hong Kong open to classifying heatstroke as an occupational disease: labour chief
news.summary:
Hong Kong authorities are open to classifying heatstroke as an occupational disease, the city’s labour chief has said, acknowledging that the recently revamped heat warning system would have triggered stronger alerts on two exceptionally hot days last month.
